The person's library, playlists and listening.

## Connect accounts

Each person connects their own Spotify account once, in the Gateway, and every app that asks for it uses that connection. Apps never see the tokens. [How connecting works](/docs/connect-oauth)

- **Make the OAuth app here:** [developer.spotify.com](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard)
- **Settings:** `SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID`, `SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET`
- **Added with:** `pnpm everyapp provider add --oauth spotify`

### Redirect URI

Register this at the provider:

```text
https://<your gateway>/connect/spotify/callback
```

`<your gateway>` is your Gateway's address, like `apps.example.com`. `pnpm everyapp provider show spotify` prints the exact URI.

### Make the OAuth app

1. Open [developer.spotify.com](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard) and create an OAuth app (sometimes called a client or an integration).
2. Add the redirect URI above.
3. Allow the scopes behind the sets your apps use (the table below), and no others.
4. Copy the client ID and the client secret. The secret is often shown once.

Steps for this provider are brief. [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Spotify) to request a full guide.

### Set it on your Gateway

From your EveryApp folder:

```bash
pnpm everyapp provider add --oauth spotify
pnpm everyapp secret set SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET
```

Each value goes in at a hidden prompt. Or, as an owner or admin, paste the client in **Manage workspace → Providers → Add OAuth provider**.

### Scope sets

Apps ask for named sets, never raw scopes, and the Gateway holds each app to the sets it declared.

| Set | Allows | Provider scopes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `identity` | Spotify account (who you are) | `user-read-email`, `user-read-private` |
| `library.read` | Saved tracks and albums (read) | `user-library-read` |
| `playlists.read` | Playlists (read) | `playlist-read-private`, `playlist-read-collaborative` |
| `playlists.write` | Playlists (read and change) | `playlist-read-private`, `playlist-modify-private`, `playlist-modify-public` |

### Use it in an app

```ts
capabilities: {
  "spotify": { access: "read", scopes: ["library.read"], why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

### Check it worked

- `pnpm everyapp provider show spotify` shows the client as set, and the redirect URI.
- Open the account menu → **Connected accounts** → **Connect Spotify**. You land back in the Gateway, connected.
- `pnpm everyapp provider connections` lists who has connected.
